title: 09. Production & Safety: Jailbreak Detection (Part 1 of 3)
summary: Jailbreaks are attempts to bypass safety restrictions through creative prompting — roleplay scenarios, fictional framing, hypothetical questions, or social engineering. Detection identifies these patterns and refuses them.
